screener_description: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd was incorporated on September 15, 1995. [1] It manufactures biscuits and bakery products that are marketed under Mrs. Bector’s Cremica and Mrs. Bector’s English Oven brands, respectively [2] Mrs. Rajni Bector started the enterprise in 1978 by manufacturing ice creams, bread, and biscuits. [3] It is promoted by Mr. Anoop Bector who has over 25 years of industry experience. He is also the Managing Director of the Company. [4]
